en.title: DMX USB Interface (RP2040)
en.description:
A dual-universe USB DMX interface based on the RP2040 microcontroller (Raspberry Pi Pico), emulating the industry-standard Enttec DMX USB Pro Mk2 protocol.

Key features:
  • Enttec Pro Mk2 Emulation: Native compatibility with major lighting software like QLC+ without requiring custom drivers.
  • Dual Universe Output: Two full DMX-512 universes driven via MAX485 transceivers.
  • OLED Menu System: Built-in SSD1306 display and 4-button physical interface for on-device configuration and status monitoring.
  • Standalone CUE Engine: Record and store up to 10 dual-universe CUEs directly to onboard flash memory.
  • DMX Crossfading: Smooth scene transitions with configurable fade times.
  • Smart Disconnect Behavior: Configurable fallback modes upon USB loss (Blackout, Hold Last Value, or Play CUE).
  • Hardware Protection: Galvanic isolation for safe operation in demanding stage and lighting environments.

en.title: MagicJS - QXW File Processor
en.description:
Web application that automatically synchronizes LED colors on the Akai APC Mini MK2 MIDI controller with button colors configured in the QLC+ Virtual Console.

How it works:
  • Workspace Analysis: Parses QLC+ workspace files (.qxw) to extract button appearance and color definitions.
  • RGB Distance Matching: Calculates the closest matching MIDI color for each button using RGB Euclidean distance.
  • Automatic Configuration: Injects the appropriate MIDI parameters into the workspace to light up the hardware controller LEDs to match the software interface.
  • Configurable Behaviors: Customizable brightness, button press responses, and LED blinking rates.
  • Client-Side Processing: Runs entirely in the browser with no backend required.

en.title: INAV Magnetometer Alignment Helper
en.description:
Interactive web application built with Vue, Three.js, and Element Plus to simplify magnetometer sensor alignment in the INAV flight controller firmware for drones and RC aircraft.

Key features:
  • Interactive 3D Visualization: Renders a 3D drone/sensor model in real time using Three.js to visualize physical orientation changes.
  • Intuitive Orientation Sliders: Easily adjust pitch, roll, and yaw angles until the 3D model orientation accurately reflects the physical board setup.
  • CLI Command Generator: Automatically generates the required INAV CLI configuration commands ready to be pasted directly into INAV Configurator.
  • In-Browser Utility: Runs entirely client-side with no installation required.
